title: Learning Normal Coordinates on Riemannian Manifolds with Flow Charts
abstract: arXiv:2610.28302v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Riemannian manifolds are powerful models for problems with non-Euclidean structure. Recent work in geometric machine learning has focused on training deep neural networks to learn Riemannian metrics from high-dimensional data. However, many geometric algorithms require repeated evaluations of the exponential and logarithmic maps, whose high computational cost restricts the utility of learned Riemannian manifolds in practice. We propose to address this cost by training a conditional invertible neural network, called a flow chart, to approximate normal coordinates around points on a given Riemannian manifold. With this approach, the exponential and logarithmic maps can be approximated by fast Euclidean operations in the model's learned coordinate space. Our main contribution is an efficient loss function for training flow charts that is nonnegative and, under suitable domain assumptions, is zero precisely when the chart is normal. Across s

translated_title: 基于流图的黎曼流形正规坐标学习
translated_abstract: 黎曼流形是处理具有非欧几里得结构问题的强大模型。近年来几何机器学习领域的工作主要集中在训练深度神经网络从高维数据中学习黎曼度量。然而，许多几何算法需要反复计算指数映射和对数映射，其高昂的计算成本限制了学习到的黎曼流形在实践中的实用性。我们提出通过训练一个称为流图的条件可逆神经网络来近似给定黎曼流形上各点周围的正规坐标，以解决这一计算成本问题。通过这种方法，指数映射和对数映射可以在模型学习到的坐标空间中通过快速的欧氏运算来近似。我们的主要贡献是一个用于训练流图的高效损失函数，该函数是非负的，并且在适当的定义域假设下，当且仅当该坐标图是正规坐标时损失为零。
tldr: 提出训练条件可逆神经网络“流图”来近似黎曼流形上的正规坐标，并设计了非负且仅在坐标图为正规时才为零的高效损失函数，使指数映射和对数映射可通过快速欧氏运算近似，大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes training conditional invertible neural networks ("flow charts") to approximate normal coordinates on Riemannian manifolds, with an efficient nonnegative loss that vanishes exactly when the chart is normal, enabling exponential and logarithmic maps to be approximated by fast Euclidean operations.
